# Xahau Muse Skill

It lets your Muse interact with the Xahau network: send XAH payments, manage trustlines, mint URITokens, claim the monthly reward. Safety-first design: the skill can only propose transactions — nothing moves until you tap approve in the Xaman app on your phone, testnet is the default network, and no wallet seed ever touches the skill. Crypto caution: real funds are at stake on mainnet — start on testnet and review every proposal before approving.
